lines: PASS tap/swipe conflict: a tap (3 px) in the look area never orbits the camera and never leaves DRAG state — {"before":{"state":"FOLLOW","err":0,"yaw":0,"dragging":false},"after":{"state":"FOLLOW","err":0,"yaw":0,"dragging":false}}

PASS double fire: one swipe → one DRAG session → the orbit PERSISTS after release (ORBIT, not dragging, yaw unchanged: no second orbit, no return) — SUPERSEDED — O1: the old one-return expectation — {"during":{"state":"DRAG","err":-45.84,"yaw":0.8,"dragging":true},"after_release":{"state":"ORBIT","err":-45.84,"yaw":0.8,"dragging":false},"settled":{"state":"ORBIT","err":-45.84,"yaw":0.8,"dragging":false}}
PASS interrupted drag (window blur mid-drag): no stuck DRAG (orbit persists per O1; the explicit reset then returns behind him) — {"state":"ORBIT","err":-34.38,"yaw":0.6,"dragging":false}
PASS interrupted drag → explicit reset returns behind him (|err| < 5°) — {"state":"FOLLOW","err":0,"yaw":0,"dragging":false}

PASS background → foreground: hidden mid-drag + mid-move releases the drag and the keys (no stuck pressed state); back in front the view is where the finger left it (ORBIT, not dragging) — SUPERSEDED — O1: the old return-behind expectation — {"hidden":{"state":"ORBIT","err":-7.83,"yaw":0.6,"dragging":false},"move":{"f":0,"in_fwd":0},"back":{"state":"ORBIT","err":-6.7,"yaw":0.6,"dragging":false}}

PASS rapid release/re-drag: the second swipe takes over at once (DRAG, nothing fights the finger), then the orbit persists (ORBIT) — SUPERSEDED — O1: the old single-return expectation — {"re_drag":{"state":"DRAG","err":-22.92,"yaw":0.883,"dragging":true},"held":{"state":"DRAG","err":-22.92,"yaw":0.883,"dragging":true},"settled":{"state":"ORBIT","err":-22.92,"yaw":0.883,"dragging":false}}

PASS modal race: the menu opened mid-drag owns input (no orbit from further movement), release + close leaves no DRAG and the menu closed — SUPERSEDED — O1: the old FOLLOW-behind expectation — {"menu_open":true,"yaw_before":0.983,"yaw_after_move":0.983,"settled":{"state":"ORBIT","err":-28.65,"yaw":0.983,"dragging":false}}
NOT EXERCISED click-through: drag starting on a control — desktop has no touch buttons on the look path; the mouse handlers only start a drag on the canvas (#view)

PASS lock → unlock: lock-on engaged and released cleanly; after unlock the camera (in FOLLOW after the reset) is behind his facing again — {"locked":true,"after":{"state":"FOLLOW","err":0,"yaw":0.483,"dragging":false}}
PASS stuck pressed state: mouseup outside the canvas still ends the drag (no DRAG, orbit persists per O1) — {"state":"ORBIT","err":-28.65,"yaw":0.983,"dragging":false}
PASS duplicate / stale listeners: 3 swipes → exactly 3 DRAG sessions — {"drag_sessions":3}
NOT EXERCISED swipe/slider conflict — no slider lives on the look path (the Control Lab overlay stops pointer propagation at its root — inspected, not exercised here)
NOT EXERCISED duplicated audio — the camera path plays no audio
NOT EXERCISED network loss — the demo authority is in-page; no network on the camera path
NOT EXERCISED async results landing after UI ownership changed — no async result feeds the camera (the follow reads the live root yaw each frame)
